item.title: NHL Rumors: Devils Attempted To Trade Two Players
item.description: The New Jersey Devils may not have landed Quinn Hughes, but they were clearly trying to create the flexibility to do something big. Reports from ESPN’s Kevin Weekes indicate the Devils attempted to move both Dougie Hamilton and Ondrej Palat in recent trade discussions, a sign that general manager Tom Fitzgerald has been actively probing the market. item.description: Lukas Reichel’s fresh start in Vancouver has already hit another dead end.
